description: DONNEE - Ouvrages du domaine public fluvial (DPF) gérés par le Service Régional de l'Ill is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région GRAND EST. Ensemble des ouvrages présents sur le réseau géré par le Service Régional de l'Ill (ouvrages domaniaux, non domaniaux). Coverage: Région GRAND EST. The publisher named on the listing is Région GRAND EST. Its keywords include reseau-hydrographique, donnees-ouvertes, schema-de-gestion, ill-domaniale, geoportail, digue. The listing shows 2019-04-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
